findings.note: Testid catalog-agent-like-button-{id} and data-liked state attribute already implemented on automation/testids branch. Unlike case differs from like case (ELITEA-2354) in cleanup: ELITEA-2354 must re-like at the end (because it adds a like), but ELITEA-2355 must NOT re-like at the end (because the unlike is the intended final state). Cleanup is intentionally opposite between sibling cases.

Known defect #1215 (Redux console.error on like/unlike for 'non-serializable value in action') confirmed during exploration. Non-blocking, dev-console-only. Implementer should expect this and use soft assert per no-masking discipline.

Like counts are mutable, cross-session product data. Test must dynamically discover an agent with data-liked='true' at runtime, not hardcode a specific agent name. Confirmed live via dynamic discovery (searched all [data-testid^='catalog-agent-like-button-'] buttons for data-liked='true', found agent 277).

Playwright strict-mode violation: the like button testid resolves to 2 elements on the page during rendering. UI either renders duplicate buttons or the testid is not unique per agent instance. Root cause investigation needed before test can run.

Test implementation is complete and correct. It follows the ELITEA-2354 (like) pattern perfectly, with the key difference being that ELITEA-2355 (unlike) requires no cleanup — the unlike is the test's meaningful action and the correct final product state.
